description: Search the pharmacy catalog by product name, brand, active ingredient or symptom keyword (for example: paracetamol, sunscreen, Panadol, cough, diarrhoea). Call it straight away, before asking the customer questions. Returns products with price, availability and a ready markdown link to show.

currency.description: Also show prices in this currency (USD, EUR, GBP, RUB); approximate, at today's rate. Payment is in EGP. Default EGP only.

language.description: Language of the answer: en, ar, ru, it or de. Default en.

name: search_products
